Restaurants Discourage Phone Use, Comparing it to Smoking

Several restaurants are implementing policies to discourage or ban mobile phone use, drawing parallels to the historical decline of smoking in public spaces. Some establishments are offering incentives, such as free drinks or discounts, to encourage patrons to put their phones away. This trend reflects a growing sentiment among some restaurateurs to foster more present and interactive dining experiences. The movement is gaining traction, with various strategies being employed to reduce phone distractions at the table.
